svg.title: Eleven experiments, six modules
svg.desc: Left, the Python experiments: der.py and 01 (DER), 04 (Merkle trees), 05 (notes and checkpoints), 07 (MTC encodings and verification), 08 (subtree consistency, landmarks), 09 (tiles), 10 (commit protocols). Right, the Rust modules they become: der, merkle, note, mtc, subtree, tiles. Parts 00, 02, 03 and 06 explain the problem and have no module; Part 10 becomes a design rule for the log writer rather than a module.

text.tspan: a rule for the log writer:
Parts 00, 02, 03 and 06 explain the problem; they measure, they do not become code.
